title: Stagelight
description: Make Your Stage Shine - With Redstone!
body:
# Stagelight

Stagelight adds directional **spotlights** that actually light what they point at. Stagelight casts a straight beam: it brightens the surfaces along its path and throws a widening cone of light onto the wall or floor where it lands. Great for stage and theater lighting, searchlights, vehicle headlights, or simply putting light exactly where you want it.

It's fully self-contained — pure vanilla + Fabric API, with no render libraries or other dependencies.

## Placing & aiming

The spotlight mounts three ways and the beam points out from the face you place it on:

- **Hang** it under a block → beam shines **down**
- **Stand** it on the floor → beam shines **up**
- **Bracket** it to a wall → beam shines **outward**

The beam always travels along an axis — one of the six straight directions. **Sneak + right-click** re-aims it to the next direction.

## Redstone control

Stagelight receives redstone like any other block, and the **signal strength sets the beam**:

- Stronger signal → a **longer, brighter** beam (analog, 0–15)
- No signal → off
- Wire it to levers, comparators, daylight sensors, or a redstone-dust line for per-lamp variation

**Right-click** toggles a full-power override, so a lamp works with no wiring at all. Turn the override off to hand full control to redstone — ideal for sequenced lighting cues and blackouts.

## Headlights

Place several spotlights side by side facing the same way and their cones **merge into one broad beam** — a multi-block headlight or floodlight.

## Crafting

```
[ ] [I] [ ]     I = Iron Ingot
[I] [G] [I]     G = Glowstone
[ ] [R] [ ]     R = Redstone Dust
```

## Compatibility

- Minecraft **1.21.11**, **Fabric** (requires Fabric API).
- No other dependencies — no render or library mods needed.
